_comment: ADO → CIX Roadmap sync configuration. Edit this file to adjust org, area paths, and field mappings without touching the sync script.

ado._comment_areaRoot: All work items UNDER this area path will be fetched. Uses ADO 'UNDER' operator.

sources._comment: STRICT include pattern: keep all queries disabled by default and drive sync from follow[]. This prevents accidental bulk import from area path/tag queries.

follow._comment: Follow list is the allow-list. Add only items that must appear in roadmap. ID or full URL both supported.

_comment_areaPathMap: Maps a roadmap area (Storage/Compute/AKS/Horizontal) to one or more substrings. An ADO item's System.AreaPath is checked with contains() against each substring. First match wins. Update these to match your actual ADO area path structure.
_comment_fallbackArea: Area assigned when no areaPathMap entry matches. Set to null to skip unmatched items.

fieldMap._comment: ADO field reference names for each roadmap property. Change if your org uses different field names.
fieldMap.name: System.Title

_comment_assigneeFormat: How to render the assignee name. 'firstName' = first token of displayName. 'fullName' = full displayName. 'email' = account name portion of uniqueName.

priorityMap._comment: ADO priority integers (1–4) → roadmap priority strings. Adjust labels as needed.

storyPointsSizeMap._comment: ADO story points → roadmap size (S/M/L/XL). Items outside these bounds get ''.

merge._comment: Controls how the sync merges ADO data with the existing seed file.
merge._comment_syncKey: 'link' = match by ADO work item URL (recommended). Items without a link are treated as manual and never overwritten.
merge._comment_preserveManualFields: Fields that are never overwritten by ADO even when a matching link exists. Useful for hand-written notes.
merge._comment_appendNewItems: If true, ADO items with no matching seed entry are appended to the area array.
merge._comment_removeClosedItems: If true, seed items whose ADO work item is now Closed/Removed will be deleted. Safer to leave false and handle manually.
